args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money claimed banker's rounding in its docstring but used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py failures in the nightly
build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to the nearest even
cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` was expected to round to `2.66` but rounded to `2.67`).

## Changes

- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Testing

- CI passed on branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` (run `ci-0001`, commit `08d3cd5986`).
